hits.text: 16 June — A magnitude 6.3 earthquake hits Haixi prefecture of Qinghai, killing one person and injuring four others.
28 June — A magnitude 5.2 earthquake hits Gao County in Sichuan, injuring 15 people.
21 July — A magnitude 4.9 earthquake hits Yunnan, damaging 221 homes.
8 July — A magnitude 5.0 earthquake hits Gao County in Sichuan, injuring four people and damaging 4,309 homes.
July 28 – An earthquake strikes Kumamoto Prefecture in southern Japan with a magnitude of Mww 6.8(MJMA 7.1) at a depth of 10 km (6.2 mi), killing at least 30 and injuring over 60.
